sections.heading: Michelle Obama — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Michelle Obama was born on 17 January 1964 in Chicago, and holds American nationality. She was given the name Michelle LaVaughn Robinson at birth and is publicly known as Michelle Obama.
Public records name her father, Fraser Robinson III and her mother, Marian Shields Robinson. She is a sibling of Craig Robinson.
She studied at Princeton University, Whitney M. Young Magnet High School, Harvard Law School and Woodlawn High School.
She is recorded as speaking American English and English.

sections.heading: Michelle Obama — Career and Professional Work
paras: Her professional record lists lawyer, writer, politician, podcaster, jurist and sociologist as her occupations, including work with Princeton University.

She has held the following offices: First Lady of the United States (2009–2017), attorney at law, board member, attorney at law, dean (1996–present) and executive director (2002–2005). She is affiliated with Democratic Party.
